business_summary: Shanghai Shenqi Pharmaceutical Investment Management Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, and sales of pharmaceuticals in China and internationally. The company offers patented anti-tumor drugs; topical antibacterial series; products for hypertension, hyperlipidemia, and hyperglycemia chronic diseases; classic Chinese medicine cough relief series; classic tonic product series; Miao medicine for strengthening muscles and bones series; and magical doll medicine series. It also provides toothache relief drops; parsnicillin tablets, compound amino acid vitamin capsules, compound chlorhexidine dexamethasone, nasal and mouth cleansing spray, constipation relief capsules, anwei tablets, motherwort paste, gynecological menstrual regulating tablets, Sangju cold tablets, hawthorn granules, isatis root granules, col and cough syrup, and gastritis relief granules, as well as acetaminophen, caffeine, and flavoxate tablets. The companys products are used for therapeutic areas such as anti-tumor, cold and cough relief, cardiovascular and cerebrovascular diseases, rheumatic bone pain, antifungal, tonifying and calming mind, and gynecological diseases. In addition, it is involved in wholesale and retail trade, and culture and art businesses; provision of software and information technology services. It also exports its products. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Shanghai, China.
business_summary_ko: Shanghai Shenqi Pharmaceutical Investment Management Co., Ltd.는 자회사와 함께 중국 및 국제적으로 의약품의 연구, 개발, 생산 및 판매에 참여하고 있습니다. 이 회사는 특허받은 항종양제를 제공합니다. 국소 항균 시리즈; 고혈압, 고지혈증, 고혈당 만성질환용 제품; 한약 기침 완화 시리즈; 클래식 토닉 제품 시리즈; 근육과 뼈를 강화하는 묘약 시리즈; 그리고 마법인형약 시리즈. 또한 치통 완화제를 제공합니다. 파스니실린정, 복합아미노산비타민캡슐, 복합클로르헥시딘덱사메타손, 비강 및 구강청정스프레이, 변비완화캡슐, 안위정, 익모초연장, 부인과생리조절정, 상주감기정, 산사나무과립, 이사티스뿌리과립, 콜 및 기침시럽, 위염해소과립 외에 아세트아미노펜, 카페인, 플라복세이트정 등이 있습니다. 회사의 제품은 항종양, 감기 및 기침 완화, 심혈관 및 뇌혈관 질환, 류마티스성 뼈 통증, 항진균제, 강장제 및 마음 진정제, 부인과 등의 치료 분야에 사용됩니다.
